title: What is the best way to create UI?
author: Large-Profession3490
selftext: Hey guys, I started working on a roguelite card fighting game based in a medieval setting with a dark fantasy style, I'm having some success with the images (recommendations welcomed here also), but I don't know how to have the AI create a decent UI for me, it can create images but not buttons and containers. I tried with figma and some tools like that with no luck. Any idea?

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body: What is your game running in?

replies.author: Large-Profession3490
replies.body: I started in Unity but I'm open in changing the engine. I'm more expert in Unreal Engine but it didn't feel right for a 2D card game

replies.author: JohnySilkBoots
replies.body: It’s super easy in Unreal. You just use widgets. Any game can be done in unreal, if you know how to use it. It’s actually super easy to code in unreal, and has features that make UI super easy. So I’m not sure you were an “expert” at it.

replies.author: Large-Profession3490
replies.body: I agree with all of it, but that's not the problem, the issue is I can't find a way to have an ai create the images for the UI

replies.author: JohnySilkBoots
replies.body: Then screenshot the image you want, and have figma or something break it down, and make it real fast in unreal. It would take no time at all. Hell, you could even show Claude the image in your ide terminal and have it make it for you in unreal.

replies.author: Large-Profession3490
replies.body: What's your problem? I never called myself an expert, and you still don't understand the issue I have, it's not a problem of Engine.

replies.author: JohnySilkBoots
replies.body:
Man, I have no problem, I have been trying to help you. 

You did call yourself an expert in your first comment: I’m more an expert in Unreal. 

But now I am done helping or talking to you, as you seem to be the one that took things the wrong way, when I not only helped you and told you how to solve your problem, but also just tried to give some future advice. So later.

replies.author: Large-Profession3490
replies.body: I did NOT call myself an expert, saying that i have more expertise in unreal than in Unity doesn't mean I am an expert, and even if I was It wouldnt change anything since my issue is not at all related to the engine I used, but to AI image generation, but you sound like an Unreal fanboy that has to make it all about the fact that Unreal Is superior even if It has nothing to do with the argument, also you did not try to help at all, you provided no suggestion at all to my issue. I guess you are just a troll.

comments.author: DatabaseConstant7870
comments.body: What Ai are you using? I use cursor in unity. I told it the other day to look through the web and find any free assets to use to create a tony hawk style ui system to show what trick I performed and points and it generated something perfect the first time

replies.author: Large-Profession3490
replies.body: Mostly Sonnet and Gemini with Claude or Antigravity and Windsurf, but it's able to create very very basic stuff viable only for prototyping, but I'll try Cursor thanks

comments.author: MakkoMakkerton
comments.body: I use a tool that basically uses VEO to create still images, and then allows for like images to be created based off a main reference photo. All a health bar really is just an empty health bar with shading depending on game state.
